notes:
### New
- **Stop analysis:** an ✕ next to the analysis progress in the status
  bar stops it (after the track in progress). Right-click → Analyze
  queues tracks again.
- **⌘A / Ctrl+A selects all tracks** in the open list (it used to
  select the whole window).
- **Track list waveform settings** (Settings → Appearance): show the
  waveform behind the title or in its own column, in Blue, Tri-band or
  RGB like the decks, as a full or half waveform. OpenCrate reads your
  Rekordbox and Engine DJ libraries once more after the update to get
  the colour data.
- **Waveform in the track list for tracks you add to OpenCrate:** the
  small waveform behind the title (until now only tracks from Rekordbox
  or Engine DJ had one) is drawn when OpenCrate analyses the track. Tracks
  analysed earlier get it with right-click → **Analyze**.
- **Analysis finds the key too:** tracks you add to OpenCrate get a
  musical key along with their tempo and beatgrid (shown in the Key
  column). A key already in the file's tags is left alone. Tracks
  analysed before this update get one when you right-click → **Analyze**.
- **Remove tracks from OpenCrate's own library:** select them and press ⌫,
  or right-click → **Remove from library**. OpenCrate asks first; the
  tracks also leave its playlists, and your music files are never deleted.
